headline: Seaside Police Recognize August 2026 Interaction of the Month Award Recipients
summary: The Seaside Police Department recognized Officers Patricia Greenwood, Bryan Vazquez and Braden Palma with the August 2026 Interaction of the Month Award for their teamwork, patience and compassion during a challenging call for service.
